settings.visualStyle: Immersive first-person WWII historical reenactment, Omaha Beach 6 June 1944, eye-level soldier POV, wet landing gear, gray dawn, sea spray, smoke, subdued documentary color, authentic 1944 equipment and terrain, non-graphic combat, no modern objects, no game HUD, no heroic glamour.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds = 120 seconds. Fictional composite U.S. infantry soldier POV inside the real Omaha Beach assault. One scene equals one primary action and one camera movement. Minimal short battlefield dialogue only. Do not invent famous quotations or present fictional dialogue as archival fact.
settings.customVisualStyle: Grounded photorealistic WWII first-person cinematic reenactment, handheld eye-level movement, natural overcast light, realistic sea spray, smoke and dust, non-graphic.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP01 — D-Day: Omaha Beach
movie.storySummary: A fictional composite U.S. infantry soldier experiences the opening assault on Omaha Beach on 6 June 1944, from the landing craft through the exposed beach and up toward the bluffs, ending with a fragile foothold inland.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Put the viewer in the eyes of one fictional composite American infantry soldier during the D-Day assault on Omaha Beach. Historically grounded, respectful, non-graphic, and immersive. Show the difficult landing, obstacles, regrouping, movement toward cover, ascent from the beach and first inland foothold. Do not imply the battle was won in minutes.

scenes.title: Inside the Landing Craft
scenes.description: POV inside a crowded landing craft approaching Omaha before dawn.
scenes.script: Squad leader: Stay low! Check your gear!
scenes.actionDescription: Gloved hands tighten around the rifle as the landing craft rises and drops in rough water.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view inside a WWII landing craft, wet steel ramp ahead, U.S. infantry packed shoulder to shoulder, gray dawn and sea spray, historically plausible gear, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: First-person handheld camera sways with the landing craft. Water hits the hull, soldiers brace, one squad leader gives a short order. Audio: diesel engine, waves, metal vibration, distant naval guns. No music for first four seconds, then low tension score.

scenes.title: Ramp Down
scenes.description: The ramp drops and the beach appears through smoke and surf.
scenes.actionDescription: The ramp falls and the POV soldier steps into waist-deep surf.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view over a dropped landing craft ramp toward gray Omaha Beach, surf, obstacles, smoke, scattered troops moving forward, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Ramp drops once; camera lunges forward into water. Audio: surf, distant artillery, shouted orders, metal ramp crash. One forward camera movement only.

scenes.title: Through the Surf
scenes.description: The soldier pushes through water toward the shingle.
scenes.actionDescription: POV wades forward while keeping the rifle above the water.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wet sleeves and rifle above churning surf, steel beach obstacles ahead, smoke and bluffs beyond, troops dispersed across beach.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward wading POV with heavy breathing and splashing. Audio: surf, ricochets in distance, artillery thumps, restrained percussion. No visible wounds.

scenes.title: Obstacle Cover
scenes.description: The soldier reaches a steel obstacle and crouches briefly.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV drops behind one steel obstacle for a moment, then looks toward the upper beach.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crouched behind a wet steel beach obstacle, sand and foam in foreground, shingle bank and bluffs ahead, smoke drifting, historically grounded.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera drops low behind one obstacle and tilts once toward the bluffs. Audio: surf, distant machine-gun bursts, nearby shouted order, low score.

scenes.title: The Shingle
scenes.description: The POV reaches the relative cover of the shingle bank.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier drops behind the shingle and checks the rifle.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from low cover behind Omaha shingle bank, muddy gloves checking an M1 rifle, beach visible behind through smoke, no gore.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low first-person camera settles behind cover; hands perform one quick rifle check. Audio: breathing, distant fire, surf, score briefly softens.

scenes.title: Find the Squad
scenes.script: Squad leader: We're going up the draw!
scenes.actionDescription: The POV soldier turns toward a small group forming beside the bluff.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view of several U.S. infantrymen crouched behind shingle and rubble, squad leader pointing toward a draw in the bluff, smoke and sea behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: One slow pan from beach cover to the regrouping squad. Audio: short order, wind, artillery, restrained score.

scenes.title: Engineer Gap
scenes.description: Engineers work on a passage through beach obstacles and wire.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV watches an engineer signal a safe route forward.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view at base of Omaha bluff, engineer beside marked wire gap and disturbed sand, squad waiting in cover, no explosion in frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera holds on engineer, then he gives one hand signal. Audio: wire rattle, distant blasts, short command, music pulse.

scenes.title: Move to the Bluff
scenes.description: The squad runs across a short exposed section to the bluff base.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV makes one short dash from cover to the base of the bluff.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person sprint toward grassy bluff base, boots and rifle entering frame, smoke drifting across upper beach, squadmates ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Single forward sprint camera move ending in hard stop at bluff cover. Audio: boots, breathing, one shouted Go, distant fire.

scenes.title: Climb
scenes.description: The group begins climbing a rough route up the bluff.
scenes.actionDescription: Hands grab earth and grass while climbing behind another soldier.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands climbing a steep grassy Normandy bluff, boots of a squadmate above, beach far below partially visible, no graphic combat.
scenes.videoPrompt: Upward first-person climb with one continuous camera rise. Audio: breathing, loose soil, distant battle sounds, low persistent score.

scenes.title: Above the Beach
scenes.description: The POV reaches the top and looks back briefly.
scenes.script: POV Soldier: We made the top.
scenes.actionDescription: The soldier pulls onto the high ground and turns once toward the beach below.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view from top of Normandy bluff looking down toward Omaha Beach through smoke, landing craft offshore, troops moving inland, non-graphic.
scenes.videoPrompt: Camera rises over edge, then performs one slow look back toward the beach. Audio: wind, distant surf and guns, quiet line from POV soldier.

scenes.title: Hedgerow
scenes.description: The squad moves into the first hedgerow beyond the bluff.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV pushes through one opening in a dense hedgerow.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person approach to thick Normandy hedgerow and narrow farm lane, squadmate signaling caution, wet vegetation, gray morning.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow forward move through one hedgerow gap. Audio: leaves, distant battle, short warning, music restrained.

scenes.title: Farm Lane
scenes.description: The soldiers cross a narrow farm lane toward cover.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV crosses the lane and takes position behind a stone wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person crossing a narrow Normandy lane toward low stone wall and orchard, squadmates spread out, historically plausible rural landscape.
scenes.videoPrompt: One lateral-forward camera move across lane ending behind wall. Audio: boots, birds briefly audible under distant artillery, low score.

scenes.title: First Foothold
scenes.description: The squad pauses in an orchard above the beachhead.
scenes.script: Squad leader: We keep moving inland.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV reloads while listening to the squad leader.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands loading ammunition in a small Normandy orchard, squad leader nearby, smoke faintly visible beyond hedgerow.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static first-person shot with one reload action. Audio: magazine and bolt sounds, short order, distant guns, steady score.

scenes.title: Beach Behind Us
scenes.description: A final glance shows the scale of the landing below.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV turns toward a gap in the hedgerow revealing the beach in the distance.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person distant view back toward Omaha from inland high ground, landing craft offshore and movement on beach, smoke thinning, respectful documentary tone.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow pan through hedgerow gap toward distant beach. Audio: wind, far surf, artillery fading slightly, reflective score.

scenes.title: Inland
scenes.description: The squad disappears down a farm track as the battle continues.
scenes.actionDescription: The POV follows the squad down one narrow farm track away from the coast.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person view following a small U.S. infantry squad down a Normandy farm track between hedgerows, early morning light, battle still audible behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear-follow first-person movement down farm track, steady pace. Audio: boots, distant battle, restrained rising score. End without victory celebration.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.description: Anonymous fictional composite soldier used only as the viewer's first-person perspective; historically plausible 1944 U.S. infantry uniform and equipment; face generally not shown.
characters.mainOutfit: M1941/M1943-compatible field gear, M1 helmet, web equipment, wet uniform, M1 rifle

voiceProfile.voiceTone: young adult male, breathless but restrained

continuity.continuityRules: Keep sleeves, gloves, rifle, helmet shadow and web gear consistent. Avoid showing a clear face unless absolutely necessary.

atmosphereAssets.title: Omaha Surf Line
atmosphereAssets.description: Gray rough surf, landing craft, steel beach obstacles, smoke, steep bluffs beyond.

atmosphereAssets.title: Omaha Beach and Bluff Base
atmosphereAssets.description: Wide sandy/tidal beach, shingle bank, wire, obstacles, bluff base and narrow draws.

atmosphereAssets.title: Normandy Inland Hedgerows
atmosphereAssets.description: Dense hedgerows, farm lanes, stone walls and small orchards immediately inland.
